company.name: Sourcegraph
company.shortDescription: The complete AI SDLC platform where devs can compose code, contextualize knowledge, and catalyze delivery.
company.description:
Sourcegraph makes universal code search so developers can work on solving problems, not struggle with finding code. With rapidly growing codebases, a proliferating number of repos, multiple languages and file formats, and a wide variety of developer tools, Sourcegraph empowers developers to quickly find, fix, and better understand all code faster.

Code navigation and code exploration improve developer productivity, contextual code intelligence enables better code reviews and onboarding for new hires, and code change campaigns automate large-scale changes. Sourcegraph is backed by top-tier investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Goldcrest Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. It was founded by Quinn Slack and Beyang Liu in 2013 and is a remote workplace with headquarters in San Francisco, California.
